findings.title: Receipt setup failure can orphan the detached workload
findings.trigger: Writing child.pid fails after successful detached Bun.spawn, before entry to the cleanup try/finally. For example, a full filesystem or removal of the receipt directory makes writeFileSync throw.
findings.proof: The captured source spawned at lines 38-42 and wrote child.pid at line 44; its cleanup region began at line 65. src/command_runner.ts:24-26 kills the separate supervisor process group, then ignores failure to read the missing workload PID.
findings.repair: Own the workload immediately after successful spawn; enclose all subsequent setup and execution in cleanup that always stops the owned process group.
findings.required_proof: Inject PID receipt write failure after a real bounded child starts, and assert its process group exits. No reproduction or suite was run by this reviewer.
findings.disposition: Parent accepted for repair; candidate freeze lifted during this attempt. This record describes the captured candidate and does not certify the changed tree.

findings.title: Consumer installation guide contradicts current paths and loader behavior
findings.trigger: A consumer follows the installation tree, expects old files, or expects an existing generated Claude import and unresolved symbolic links to remain unchanged.
findings.proof: src/installation/plan.ts:14-17 installs managed content beneath .orly. src/loaders.ts:162-170 refreshes recognized owned loader content. src/model.ts:85-90 refuses unresolved symbolic links. Interrupted installation recovery also retains journaled partial writes; the blanket no-change claim exceeds that guarantee.
findings.repair: Describe .orly paths, preserved foreign content, refreshed recognized owned imports, unresolved-link refusal, and recovery limits accurately.
findings.required_proof: Read the corrected README alongside production installation and loader code; no publication or live consumer success follows from this documentation check.
findings.disposition: Sent to parent; requires verification on a fresh candidate.

findings.title: Integration guidance still requires explicit draining despite wrapper-owned cleanup
findings.trigger: An agent follows this integration skill with PgQuery, whose owner deinit drains on early exits, or with a repository lacking a declared drain checker.
findings.proof: The skill requires same-function .drain and the declared drain check, while dispatch/write_zig.md:298 accepts wrapper-owned cleanup and only actually declared checks. The canonical recipe at lines 479-494 uses defer q.deinit, which auto-drains.
findings.repair: Require draining before connection release on every exit, accept verified wrapper-owned cleanup, and run only actually declared checks while reviewing the owner path.
findings.required_proof: Read current skill, dispatch and questionnaire wording together after the correction. No Zig build is authorized or performed.
findings.disposition: Sent to parent; requires verification on a fresh candidate.
